- Pulse AI: only the chat is left, on an AMOLED black screen. The menu at the top left opens a drawer with the chats, Models, the mascot and the floating mascot settings, and a + for a new chat. The AI lyrics are removed.
- Pulse AI mascot: the Claude Chat mascot with its looks (44 hats and costumes, 12 body colours, faces, eyes, shoes, trousers, body extras, 27 scenes, waiting moves). A tap makes it move and say something; a long press opens the customize sheet.
- A floating mascot over every app and Claude Chat's bar (pill, line, curtain) copied from Claude Chat, wearing the same look; Pulse's own Island shows "Pulse AI - Working..." as the default bar.
- Music: the Sonic record cover is round again; the separate Lyrics look is removed and a player still on it opens on Poweramp (also the default).
- Game Hub: the disc goes into the console with Boxshelf's own original insert animation.
- Keyboard: the password manager's chip is tappable again and sits on the keys' grey; the clipboard shows the newest copied item first and has list, grid and photo-size views.
- Office: the Word and PDF pages fit the screen with a little space at the sides and can be made much smaller; Excel keeps moving after a flick; the searches ignore capitals and Turkish letters, Word jumps to the first hit and all say Not found when there is none.
- Office: on a tablet the ribbon stays open in landscape (it hides itself only on a phone).
- Keyboard: the neural correction looks at fewer near words (6), and it switches itself off sooner on a slow phone, so typing stays smooth.
